summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing an abridged and unaudited quarterly results press release for Q1 2026. The filing reports quarterly financials, production metrics, and a declared dividend of 14 cents per share. No special situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is described. The filing is a routine earnings release and dividend declaration, not a special situation.
